recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source edit is needed for FHIR-19568 unless a future work-group decision changes the cross-format rule for empty primitive values.
issue_request: FHIR-19568 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I change request against the FHIR-core conformance rules cardinality section. It asked for the sentence after "elements cannot be empty" to clarify that a primitive value attribute itself cannot be empty, consistent with the serialization rules.
initial_application: The issue was applied in commit 44ad3ffcf04a71a9affa02374a8596ac9ade7bfa, which updated source/conformance-rules.html for FHIR-19568, FHIR-19570, and FHIR-19571. The FHIR-19568 hunk added that the element value attribute/property can never be empty and must either be absent or contain at least one non-whitespace character.
additional_context: source/conformance-rules.html is an active built page listed in publish.ini, and the current cardinality section still contains the added clarification. source/formats.html independently states the same rule for primitive value attributes/properties. Jira searches for the same empty-value cardinality wording found only FHIR-19568, and community searches found no conflicting Confluence record; a Zulip implementers thread shows the same practical XML empty-value question and points users to the serialization rule.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current source already satisfies the Jira request and remains consistent with the serialization page.
